text:
julia: Quick one - I opened a tiny PR to clarify a proxy/trace propagation example in the observability guide. Some customers copy-paste the nginx snippet and end up dropping the runtimes `x-rd-trace` header. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3031

rahul: link? what did you change exactly?
julia: summary: replaced a case-mismatched header example, added a short note about proxies normalizing headers, and included a compact curl-based debug command to verify trace propagation (`curl -H 'x-rd-trace: test-123' https://<your-app>/ping -v`). Also removed an old `prefetch: true` line from the dashboard preset that confused users.

maria: nice. can the curl snippet include an example of the response header we expect back (e.g., `x-rd-trace: test-123`) so folks can quickly see success/failure?
julia: done, added a one-line expected response example and a tiny troubleshooting bullet: "If the header is missing, check ingress rules and any middleware that overwrites request headers."

rahul: docs-bot flagged a broken internal link in the migration section. docs-bot, paste the failure?
docs-bot: Linkcheck: 1 broken internal link in docs/observability/trace-propagation.md line 62 -> /sdk/telemetry/old-format (404). Suggestion: point to /sdk/migration/telemetry-headers.

maria: let's not just replace links; can we add a short compatibility note that Dedicated/private customers on pinned SDKs might see `trace_id` fields named differently? A single-line note should do.
julia: added a compatibility note referencing the migration guide. also added a short changelog entry under the observability doc: "Clarified proxy header handling; added debug curl snippet; removed stale preset key."

rahul: i'll open a site-config redirect to avoid future link rot once this merges. small ask: can the nginx snippet explicitly use `proxy_set_header x-rd-trace $http_x_rd_trace;` instead of a generic example? less cognitive load for readers.
julia: updated nginx line as suggested. kept it minimal to avoid duplication across other pages.

maria: tiny wording nit in the troubleshooting bullet, left an inline suggestion. otherwise LGTM.
julia: squashed fixups and pushing. merging after CI green and site-config redirect PR is created.

rahul: site-config PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/site-config/pull/402 - 301 from /sdk/telemetry/old-format -> /sdk/migration/telemetry-headers. will ping infra for quick review.
julia: thanks all 680
